name: File MIME
description: Rewrites the extension-to-MIME-type map Drupal uses when guessing an uploaded file's MIME type, from a server mime.types file and/or administrator-supplied overrides.
project_description: Drupal determines the MIME type of each uploaded file by applying an extension-to-MIME-type mapping to the file name. The default mapping is hard-coded in core's ExtensionMimeTypeGuesser. The File MIME module lets site administrators alter that built-in mapping. For example, you may wish to serve FLAC files as audio/flac rather than application/x-flac. On the File MIME settings page the mapping can be extracted from the server's mime.types file and/or configured via a text field, and can also be applied retroactively to all previously uploaded files via a batch. Uninstalling the module restores Drupal's built-in mapping.
